detail:
Found 8 of 10 bright, 7 of 10 medium, and 8 of 10 faint simulated movers; 1 candidate in the untouched pictures.

Each simulated mover was hidden in these same pictures at a random place, moving between 0.66″ and 9.5″ per year. Bright means 30 times the noise at its peak, medium 12, faint 6. It counts as found only if the finder reports the right speed and direction to within 15 percent. Candidates in the untouched pictures are false alarms unless something there really does move. The finder also reported 10 wrong candidates during the test.
